plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Bug fix: clicking a teacher playlist was sending the plugin's own internal row id to Spotify's API instead of the actual Spotify playlist id, causing every playlist load to fail with 400/403 regardless of how correctly it was configured in Settings. This was the real root cause behind the errors some admins were seeing even with a valid playlist link saved - now fixed.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
